name: helm-unittest
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      PRIMUS_REF:
        description: "The primus ref to checkout."
        required: true
        default: "main"
        type: string

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  PRIMUS_HOME: .primus
  MAKE: make --no-print-directory --makefile=.primus/src/make/main.mk

jobs:
  helm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: "read"
      id-token: "write"
    steps:
      - name: self-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref }}
          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name || github.repository }}
      - id: token
        name: github-token-gen
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.PRIMUS_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.PRIMUS_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
      - name: primus-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: signoz/primus
          ref: ${{ inputs.PRIMUS_REF }}
          path: .primus
          token: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
      - name: info
        run: |
          $MAKE info
      - name: helm-unittest
        run: |
          $MAKE helm-unittest

name: yaml-lint
on:
  workflow_call:
    
jobs:
  yaml:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: 'read'
    steps:
      - name: self-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: yaml-targets
        id: changed-yaml-files
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Without a base, such as the first push of a branch, every file is linted.
          if [[ -z "${BASE_SHA}" || "${BASE_SHA}" =~ ^0+$ ]]; then
            echo "files=." >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
            exit
          fi

          # Deleted files are left out, there is nothing left to lint.
          files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d "${BASE_SHA}...${HEAD_SHA}" -- '*.yml' '*.yaml' | tr '\n' ' ')
          echo "files=${files% }" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Run yaml-lint action on changed files
        if: steps.changed-yaml-files.outputs.files != ''
        uses: ibiqlik/action-yamllint@2576378a8e339169678f9939646ee3ee325e845c # v3.1.1
        with:
          file_or_dir: ${{ steps.changed-yaml-files.outputs.files }}
          strict: true

name: github-pr-approve

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      GITHUB_ENVIRONMENT:
        description: 'The environment to run the Primus GitHub operation in.'
        default: 'production'
        type: string
      PRIMUS_REF:
        description: 'The primus ref to checkout.'
        required: true
        default: 'main'
        type: string

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  PRIMUS_HOME: .primus
  MAKE: make --no-print-directory --makefile=.primus/src/make/main.mk

jobs:
  approver:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: 'read'
      id-token: 'write'
    steps:
      - name: self-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: token
        name: github-token-gen
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ inputs.GITHUB_ENVIRONMENT == 'production' && secrets.PRIMUS_APP_ID || secrets.NP_PRIMUS_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ inputs.GITHUB_ENVIRONMENT == 'production' && secrets.PRIMUS_PRIVATE_KEY || secrets.NP_PRIMUS_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
      - name: primus-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: signoz/primus
          ref: ${{ inputs.PRIMUS_REF }}
          path: .primus
          token: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
      - name: info
        run: |
          $MAKE info
      - name: approve
        env:
          GH_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GH_PULL_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number}}
        run: |

name: github-pr-update-merge

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      GITHUB_ENVIRONMENT:
        description: 'The environment to run the Primus GitHub operation in.'
        default: 'production'
        type: string
      PRIMUS_REF:
        description: 'The primus ref to checkout.'
        default: 'main'
        type: string
      MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        description: 'Maximum number of automerge attempts.'
        type: number
        default: 2
      SLEEP_SECONDS:
        description: 'Time to wait between each update-merge loop.'
        type: number
        default: 20

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  PRIMUS_HOME: .primus
  MAKE: make --no-print-directory --makefile=.primus/src/make/main.mk

jobs:
  pr-update-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: self-checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - id: token
      name: github-token-gen
      uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
      with:
        app-id: ${{ inputs.GITHUB_ENVIRONMENT == 'production' && secrets.PRIMUS_APP_ID || secrets.NP_PRIMUS_APP_ID }}
        private-key: ${{ inputs.GITHUB_ENVIRONMENT == 'production' && secrets.PRIMUS_PRIVATE_KEY || secrets.NP_PRIMUS_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
    - name: primus-checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        repository: signoz/primus
        ref: ${{ inputs.PRIMUS_REF }}
        path: .primus
        token: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
    - name: info
      run: |
        $MAKE info
    - name: update-merge
      env:
        GH_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        GH_PULL_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number}}
        MAX_ATTEMPTS: ${{ inputs.MAX_ATTEMPTS }}
        SLEEP_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.SLEEP_SECONDS }}
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
      run: |
        GH_REPOSITORY_NAME=$(echo "${GH_REPOSITORY}" | awk -F'/' '{print $2}')
        $MAKE github-pr-update-merge \
          GITHUB_ARGS="-t ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }} \
            -r ${GH_REPOSITORY_NAME} \
            --pull-number ${GH_PULL_NUMBER} \
            --max-attempts ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} \
            --sleep-seconds ${SLEEP_SECONDS}"
